tool: temporary MegaMoEV2 instrumentation + rank JSON export
purpose: Collect exact logical bytes, readiness/wait, useful/padded work, and publication counts unavailable from profilers
capability_probe: zero-work replay produces zero payload/useful-row counters
analytical tiny case matches every per-peer/per-expert counter exactly
preconditions: counter storage is rank-private or atomically updated with documented scope
counter reset and publication obey the same stream/epoch ordering as the measured replay
counter overhead is measured against an otherwise identical build
counters never alter work assignment, publication granularity, or synchronization behavior
retain raw per-rank/per-repetition records before reduction

outputs.information: instrumentation revision, command, counter scope, overhead and raw paths

not_measured: physical XGMI traffic without a hardware cross-check

provenance.notes: This collector is intentionally not marked ready until instrumentation and analytical counter tests exist.
